tooltip.laowu.fusion_wand.usage: Use on two cats in order, then use on the ground to create their adult fusion
tooltip.laowu.fusion_wand.mutation: Each texture region has a 20% mutation chance; sneak-use a cat to clear selections
message.laowu.fusion_wand.second: Selected second cat: %s; use the wand on the ground to fuse them
message.laowu.fusion_wand.same_parent: The two parents cannot be the same cat
message.laowu.fusion_wand.parents_unavai: A parent is in another dimension, unloaded, or no longer present
message.laowu.fusion_wand.spawned: Created an adult cat with fused textures
gui.laowu.cat_stats.hold_shift: Hold Shift to view Attribute Limits
gui.laowu.cat_stats.release_shift: Release Shift to view Current Attributes
item.laowu.terminator_suit.tooltip.summa: Protects its owner and deals 5 damage to enemies.
item.laowu.fishing_suit.tooltip.summary: While seated next to a container, automatically fishes in water adjacent to the block below the Seat; larger waters fish faster.
item.laowu.flight_suit.tooltip.summary: Sneak-use the cat to open its 27-slot portable inventory.
item.laowu.fire_suit.tooltip.summary: While seated, keeps adjacent Blaze Burners kindled without fuel.
item.laowu.honey_suit.tooltip.summary: While seated, increases the honey level of a hive or bee nest below by 1 every 10 seconds.
item.laowu.transport_suit.tooltip.summar: While seated, becomes a logistics container that carries packages between matching addresses.
item.laowu.cat_fur.tooltip: Use _Shears_ by hand or with a _Deployer_ on a cat
In this version, it works exactly like the _Engineer's Goggles_!
item.laowu.cat_sword.tooltip.summary: Can enter an _empowered state_; every third attack arms _Empowered Melee I_.
item.laowu.cat_sword.tooltip.behaviour1: Toggles _empowerment_; empowered actions consume _three times_ the Hiss.
item.laowu.cat_pickaxe.tooltip.summary: When empowered, automatically _smelts_ drops from mined blocks.
item.laowu.cat_pickaxe.tooltip.behaviour: Toggles _empowerment_; empowered actions consume _three times_ the Hiss.
item.laowu.cat_axe.tooltip.summary: When empowered, wood blocks drop their corresponding _stripped_ forms.
item.laowu.cat_axe.tooltip.behaviour1: Toggles _empowerment_; empowered actions consume _three times_ the Hiss.
item.laowu.cat_shovel.tooltip.summary: When empowered, digs dirt, sand and other shovel blocks _extremely quickly_.
item.laowu.cat_shovel.tooltip.behaviour1: Toggles _empowerment_; empowered actions consume _three times_ the Hiss.
item.laowu.cat_hoe.tooltip.summary: When empowered, tills a _3×3_ area and automatically _waters_ the farmland.
item.laowu.cat_hoe.tooltip.behaviour1: Toggles _empowerment_; the clicked block is _bottom-centre_, and Hiss use is _tripled_.
item.laowu.cat_helmet.tooltip.summary: Grants a cat's keen _night vision_ and drives away _Phantoms_.
item.laowu.cat_helmet.tooltip.behaviour1: Grants _Night Vision_ and prevents _Phantoms_ from targeting the wearer.
item.laowu.cat_chestplate.tooltip.behavi: Restores _5%% of maximum health_ every _2 seconds_.
item.laowu.cat_leggings.tooltip.behaviou: Press _[X]_ to unleash _Earthshaking Palm_; landing damage equals held attack damage, with a minimum of _4_ and a _7-second_ cooldown.
item.laowu.cat_boots.tooltip.summary: Makes _Creepers_ flee in terror and lets you _land like a cat_!
item.laowu.cat_boots.tooltip.behaviour1: Completely negates _fall damage_ and causes _Creepers_ to actively flee from the wearer.
block.laowu.hissing_collector.tooltip.su: Can only be placed on an _Encased Fan's outlet_; collects _Hiss_ produced by nearby cats or disperses its stored _fluid_.
tooltip.laowu.cat_pouch.control: Right-click inventory slots to insert or remove cat pancakes
tooltip.laowu.cat_box.control: Right-click inventory slots to insert or remove cat grenades
tooltip.laowu.hiss_exhausted: Hiss depleted; recharge it with a permeation reaction
item.laowu.smithing_template.applies_to: Diamond Tools, Potato Cannon & Engineer's Goggles
item.laowu.smithing_template.base_slot: Add a diamond tool, potato cannon or Engineer's Goggles
tooltip.laowu.cat_pancake.fan: Place in a Create fan air current to restore the cat
message.laowu.cat_tool_empower.exhausted: Hiss is depleted; empowerment cannot be enabled
message.laowu.held_item_transform.empty: Hold the item you want to adjust first
laowu.ponder.hissing_collector.text_2: 当收集网吸取气体的范围内有两只猫咪哈气时，会收集哈气
laowu.ponder.hissing_collector.text_3: 除此之外，收集网也可以向外吹气
laowu.ponder.hissing_collector.text_4: 水、岩浆可以范围洗涤或熔炼，而药水可以范围生效
laowu.ponder.infiltration_tank.text_2: 玩家无法直接放置材料，需借助漏斗等运输方式
